title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Everyone in the game
hook: Is there a game your whole team can play at once?
intro: The other half waits on the side.
statement: Whole-team games keep every kid involved.
q1: Do you use games where all players play at once —
q2: or run smaller games with rotations?
q3: How many kids are waiting right now?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But energy stays high
t2: when no one is waiting to play.
cta: Coaches — what whole-team games do you use?
ctaLines: Pickle. Relay races. Everyone has a ball.
ctaPrompt: Share your favorite game below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Is there a game your whole team can play at once?
Half the team plays. The other half waits on the side.
Whole-team games keep every kid involved.
Whole-team games or rotations. There is no single right way.
What whole-team games do you use? Share your habit in the comments.
